**HMG-API 1.1.0-beta.1 is a beta, for owners who want to help test.** If you'd rather not, stay on [1.0.2](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/releases/tag/v1.0.2): it's still the current release. The final 1.1.0 is planned for mid-November, after a release candidate. Changes from maintainers can still land until Nov 11 ([#135](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/issues/135)).

It comes with **Wireless CarPlay + Android Auto [2.2.0-beta.1](https://github.com/Open-HMG/hmgapi-wireless-cp-aa/releases/tag/v2.2.0-beta.1)**, the first release from the mod's own repository. ADB and NEMESIS in the app menu are the same as in 1.0.2.

## What's new

- **US Ioniq 5 (2023 on) on 260903: the full hook map** (351 of 351 points, up from 325). The missing 26 came from joelsmith's on-car mapping (#1). Mods that use them now run on 260903 too: the 12V battery readings, CarPlay's points, the cluster and the iAP2 (CarPlay) service.
- **No more head unit restart at car start on cars that send Digital Key data.** With a mod that reads the car, HMG-API answered one of the car's callbacks wrongly, and system_server crashed (seen on a US Niro EV 260507). Thanks to dibble9012 (#101).
- **Wireless CarPlay + Android Auto 2.2.0-beta.1:**
  - CarPlay turns on the cluster and HUD for more maneuvers: ordinary turns without an exit angle, left-hand-traffic routes, and the previous route's arrow cleared at the start. Thanks to codevalley (#15).
  - Lanes only from the phone, no longer overwritten by the car's own navigation. Thanks to AwsomeFox.
  - A new setting, off by default: Android Auto turns in the car's own format, for the AR HUD's arrow and distance bar.
  - No more loading spinner on the cluster and HUD at roundabouts with Android Auto.
- **"Support the project" in the app's Settings** opens the wiki's [Support page](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/wiki/Support), which lists each maintainer's own links.
- **For mod authors:**
  - The mod SDK (`hmgapi-mod-sdk-1.1.0-beta.1.zip`, below), for building, testing and packaging a mod in its own repository.
  - `"nemesis_conflicts"` in mod.json.
  - 12V battery sensor readings (`battery12v.*`). Thanks to zpoon (#66).
  - New hook points (DiPO Bluetooth and picture, 12V battery), mapped on every car.
  - Zips come out with the same bytes on any machine.
  - The full list is in the [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/blob/v1.1.0-beta.1/CHANGELOG.md).

## Installing

- **From 1.0.x:** put `hmgapi-1.1.0-beta.1-update.zip` in `HMGAPI/updates/` on a USB stick, then HMG-API app → **Check USB updates**. Then restart the head unit once. Your mods and settings stay. To get the wireless beta too, also put `wireless-carplay-aa-2.2.0-beta.1.zip` in `HMGAPI/updates/`, then pick it in Check USB updates and **Apply changes**.
- **With NEMESIS:** unzip `hmgapi-1.1.0-beta.1-nemesis.zip` onto a stick and update from NEMESIS Manager's Package Store.
- **New install:** as in [Installing HMG-API](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/wiki/Installing-HMG-API), with `hmgapi-1.1.0-beta.1-usb.zip`.

## What to test

- The app shows **1.1.0-beta.1** and "Hooks on". Your mods still run after the update and a restart.
- Wireless CarPlay and Android Auto connect, with turn-by-turn on the cluster and HUD: ordinary turns, roundabouts, lanes before a turn.
- **Ioniq 5 on 260903:** HMG-API app → Settings → **Check the map on this car**, then a [Car Report](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/wiki/Car-Report). Reports from two or three cars let us mark the map as checked for everyone.
- With a car that has a Digital Key: no restart at car start.
- Settings → the "Support the project" line looks right on the screen.

## Known issues

- **Ioniq 5 on 260903:** the wireless mod doesn't list this software yet, so it says "isn't for this head unit". Install anyway works, at your own risk.
- Not in this beta: Android Auto's left-hand-traffic roundabouts and "Recalculating…", keeping Bluetooth up during wireless CarPlay, and the CarPlay picture freeze fix. They're open pull requests in the wireless repo.
- The rest are the same as in [1.0.0](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/releases/tag/v1.0.0). For example, a USB stick left in the port can start wired Android Auto and stop wireless from connecting. Take the stick out after installing.

## Going back to 1.0.2

The app won't install an older HMG-API over a newer one, so either:
- **With adb:** `adb push hmgapi-1.0.2-update.zip /data/local/tmp/`, then `adb shell hmgapid engine update-hmgapi /data/local/tmp/hmgapi-1.0.2-update.zip --force`. Restart the head unit.
- **Without adb:** uninstall HMG-API ([Uninstalling](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/wiki/Uninstalling), without `PURGE`, so your mods and settings stay), restart, then install [1.0.2](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/releases/tag/v1.0.2) as new.

For wireless 2.1.0: remove the mod in the app and apply, then install `wireless-carplay-aa-2.1.0.zip` from 1.0.2's release with Check USB updates.

## Reporting

A [Car Report](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/wiki/Car-Report), or [open an issue](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/issues/new/choose) with:
- your car;
- the head unit software (e.g. 260507 or 260903);
- the HMG-API version (1.1.0-beta.1) and the wireless mod's version;
- what you did and what happened.

Problems with wireless CarPlay or Android Auto go [in the mod's repo](https://github.com/Open-HMG/hmgapi-wireless-cp-aa/issues/new/choose). Please don't post your VIN, serial numbers or phone numbers; nothing needs them.
